title: Oily Silky Vietnamese Pork Ca Kho To
description: A fermented and silky Vietnamese dish featuring serrano ham and shio-koji cure, this recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic friendly and served in a corn husk wrap.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together shio-koji, fish sauce, and black pepper to create the cure.
Add the diced serrano ham to the cure and mix well.
Place the pork belly in the bowl and coat it evenly with the cure mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours to allow the pork to ferment.
After fermentation, remove the pork from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and saute until fragrant.
Add the fermented pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Wrap each piece of pork in a corn husk and secure with a toothpick.
Serve the Ca Kho To hot, garnished with additional serrano ham if desired.
